item.title: $50 million natural gas facility planned for Lowndes County to fuel manufacturing growth
item.description: A $50 million liquefied natural gas facility is coming to Lowndes County to meet rising industrial demand and support regional manufacturing growth.

item.title: Neighbors raise questions over disabled comments on Wakulla County's public Facebook pages
item.description: The county disabled comments on its official Facebook pages at the start of the year. Residents say they want answers, and the county has declined to comment on the decision.

item.title: Florida opens new State Emergency Operations Center in Tallahassee to boost disaster response
item.description: The Florida Division of Emergency Management cut the ribbon on the new Tallahassee facility Tuesday, which is designed to keep the state operational during emergencies.
